description: E37已完成之后，按其有限来源提案登记E38；固定前三月/旧用途范围/2查询3GET，不登记预测模型或账户。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json,subprocess
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
assert not OUT.exists(),'固定来源资格已登记，不重复。'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
ref='reports/research/510300_purchase_adjustment_current_report_cause_review_v1'
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/(ref+'/next_experiment.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E38' and proposal['fixed_source_prefix_months']==['2024-01','2024-02','2024-03']
source_proto=json.loads((ROOT/(ref+'/protocol.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
raws=[r for r in source_proto['raw_reports'] if r['stat_month'] in proposal['fixed_source_prefix_months']]
assert len(raws)==3
parents=[ref+'/next_experiment.json',ref+'/protocol.json',ref+'/result.json',ref+'/人工裁决_全部24月采购原因.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/protocol_source.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/result.json']
# 先绑定相关已用方向的直接入口，后续有限搜索不宣称穷尽全项目或git历史。
prior_dirs=['reports/research/510300_historical_index_pmi_expectation_v1',
'reports/research/510300_manufacturing_price_transmission_source_v1',
'reports/research/510300_historical_price_gap_causes_v1']
for directory in prior_dirs:
 d=ROOT/directory
 assert d.exists(),directory
 for f in sorted(d.iterdir()):
  if f.is_file() and f.name in ['protocol.json','result.json','source_receipts.json','source_protocol.json','authority_update.json','source_gate.json']:
   parents.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'))
OUT.mkdir()
proto={'study_id':'510300_OFFICIAL_PMI_INTERPRETATION_CAUSE_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1',
 'experiment_id':'E38','registered_at':now(),'status':'SOURCE_ONLY_REGISTERED_BEFORE_PRIOR_USE_EXTRACTION_OR_PUBLIC_LOOKUP',
 'prior_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E37_ACTUAL_24_MONTH_MANUAL_CAUSE_REVIEW_AND_AUTHORITATIVE_FACTS',
 'question':proposal['question'],'proposal':ref+'/next_experiment.json',
 'fixed_source_prefix_months':proposal['fixed_source_prefix_months'],
 'original_data_release_anchors':raws,
 'parents':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p),'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size} for p in parents],
 'prior_use_search_scope':proposal['phase_one_prior_use_review'],
 'official_source_identity':proposal['source_identity'],'fields_to_record':proposal['source_fields_to_record'],
 'new_information_requirement':'必须独立于采购量/PMI读数的直接行为原因原句或独立问卷原因原行；要明确当期/调查总体/定义/可知时点。单纯制造业走势复述不属于独立原因测量。',
 'causal_limit':'独立原因问卷信息也不证明采购或指数收益的因果效应，不按后来的收益确定原因。',
 'source_clock':'原报告发布日期/页面发布时间/本次保存时间分别记录；初版未认证，不将当前收件伪称2024当时已收到。缺钟保留UNKNOWN。',
 'admission_rule':proposal['admission_rule'],'budget':proposal['budget'],
 'public_query_budget_semantics':'search_query每个q计1；原页实际HTTP GET每次计1，缓存已存原件可复用且不计新请求；不自动另取目录/附件。',
 'stop':proposal['stop'],'model_followup':'本实验没有预测字段准入或模型阶段；即便有不同信息，也需新的完整原支持资格和不同协议，不自动做全历史/全账户。',
 'source_code_edits':0,'parameter_grids':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False,'live_process':False,
 'dr_dependency':'用户暂时没有有效访问；E34原条件保留，不查询凭据/重试到期运输。'}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'registered':proto['study_id'],'months':proto['fixed_source_prefix_months'],
 'parents':len(parents),'source_budget':proto['budget'],'original_release_dates':[(r['stat_month'],r['published_at']) for r in raws]},ensure_ascii=False))
